preconditions.description: The number of initial cards, n, must be between 2 and 100.
The final card value, d, must be between -10000 and 10000.
The limit for the initial integers, l, must be between 1 and 100.

postconditions.description: The output must either be '-1' indicating no solution, or a sequence of n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= l for x in return_value.split())
postconditions.description: All integers in the output must be between 1 and l.
The simulation of the magic process on the output sequence must result in the final card value d.
